objective: Establish deterministic incident and postmortem records with explicit evidence lineage, ordered timeline, impact/severity classification, causal findings, corrective-action registry and closure criteria, without automated remediation, blame attribution, credential access, runtime mutation or Live authority.
scope: Define canonical incident severity and lifecycle states
Create deterministic incident records from explicit caller-supplied evidence
Require ordered event timelines with correlation/evidence lineage
Require impact scope and containment/recovery timestamps where applicable
Create deterministic postmortem records only for recovered/closed incidents
Require root-cause statement, contributing factors and evidence references
Require corrective actions with owner role, priority and verification requirement
Prevent person-name/PII fields in canonical postmortem schema
Keep corrective actions advisory/reference-only with no execution authority
tests: Timeline ordering and timestamp invariants fail closed
Evidence references must be canonical SHA-256 identifiers
Postmortem cannot close an incident before recovery
Corrective actions require explicit owner role, priority and verification requirement
PII/person-name fields are absent from canonical schema
P22-H evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P22-H incident/postmortem policy/module/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P22-A..P22-G remain canonical complete and P22-I remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
